image.name: work-recoverflow
image.alt: RecoverFlow AI evaluation dashboard with revenue at risk, simulated recovery and predicted versus actual rates

audience: RecoverFlow AI is for merchant operations teams reviewing failed recurring payments. Its repository docs also use the earlier name, PayBack AI.
problem: When recurring payments fail, retrying blindly can add fees, annoy customers and still lose the revenue. A merchant needs to know which cases are worth acting on, why, and who approved the action.
contribution: I built the Next.js and TypeScript console, the recovery domain logic, the Prisma data model and the test suites.

decisions.title: Money is stored as integer paise.
decisions.text: Floating-point rounding is not acceptable in financial records, so amounts use integer paise and probabilities use integer basis points.

decisions.title: AI can advise, but cannot move money.
decisions.text: Models are limited to classification, diagnosis, drafting and recommendations. Malformed output falls back to deterministic rules. AI can suggest a discount code when the merchant allows discounts, but cannot run payments or change audit history.

decisions.title: Some safety rules are enforced in code.
decisions.text: Opt-outs stop messages at once and contact attempts are capped at three. Quiet hours are applied per payment, and cases routed to approval need two different reviewers.

decisions.title: Webhooks can repeat, so duplicates are handled.
decisions.text: The data layer writes an event and its outbox record in one transaction and skips duplicates, covered by a PostgreSQL integration test. Live routes do not call it yet. The current Razorpay route verifies HMAC-SHA256 signatures and uses an in-memory store.

results: CI on main passed 601 unit and application tests and 82 browser tests on 28 October 2026, along with PostgreSQL, Redis and durability suites.
In the live demo's 100-invoice synthetic batch, predicted recovery was 63.4% against 50% observed, a 13.4-point gap, with a Brier score of 0.2448.
limits: Live payment recovery and provider onboarding are not enabled.
Results come from synthetic data, not real merchants.
Container smoke and worker restart tests are still open.
next: Close the gap between predicted and observed recovery, then run container smoke and worker restart tests before any live pilot.

image.name: work-sharecon-eval
image.alt: ShaRecon AI evaluation lab with synthetic benchmark precision, recall and review-routing results

audience: ShaRecon AI is for finance teams matching Razorpay payments, settlement batches and bank credits. It was built for the Razorpay AI Buildathon's AI Finance Controller track.
problem: A ₹5,000 payment can reach the bank as ₹4,882 days later, with its reference truncated. Same-day matching breaks, and identical amounts can double-credit an order. Discrepancies can go unnoticed until month-end close.
contribution: I built the reconciliation engine, the control center, the evaluation lab and the audit export.

decisions.title: AI never touches matching.
decisions.text: A deterministic engine scores and assigns matches. Gemini only writes advisory notes from the evidence, and a person makes the final call on exceptions.

decisions.title: Each record can be matched once.
decisions.text: A one-to-one assignment rule stops a settlement or bank credit from being linked twice, which prevents double-crediting.

decisions.title: Test data was kept separate from the engine.
decisions.text: Besides synthetic seeds, 80 hand-written stress cases across 14 failure modes were built separately from the generator. They stayed out of tuning until October 2026, when the engine was changed to fix the 7 unsafe cases they exposed.

incident.title: What broke
incident.text: The policy simulator disagreed with the baseline at the same thresholds. It rebuilt bank statements from matched records, which removed 9 competing records from the collision check. Passing the raw records through one shared pipeline fixed it, and regression tests now require the two results to match.

results: On 80 hand-written stress cases, link precision and recall are 97.1%. The current report also shows 100% exception accuracy, measured after the engine was changed to fix failures on these same cases.
CI on main passed 141 automated tests and 50 Playwright end-to-end tests on 23 October 2026.
limits: The first run on those cases had 7 unsafe auto-resolutions out of 42, a ₹28,100 exposure. Rules added in October removed them, so these cases can no longer count as held out.
Results come from controlled datasets and do not establish production performance.
next: Write a new, untouched stress set to re-measure the engine, then test against anonymized real settlement files.

image.name: work-resumescore
image.alt: ResumeScore home page with a fictional sample showing resume quality and job match scores

audience: ResumeScore is for candidates who want to review a resume against a job description without uploading it by default.
problem: Many resume checkers require uploading personal documents, then return a single score with little explanation. Candidates need feedback they can check, and control over where their text goes.
contribution: I built the extraction review, scoring, job matching, local editor and export workflow, along with the tests.

decisions.title: Analysis runs in the browser by default.
decisions.text: Browser-only analysis sends no resume or job text to application APIs. Server analysis and external AI are explained before use and need opt-in.

decisions.title: Unsupported skill mentions earn less credit.
decisions.text: Job matching separates required, preferred and optional terms, and reduces credit for skills that lack evidence.

decisions.title: Paid AI is locked at build time.
decisions.text: The build forces paid AI off whatever the environment says, so an accidental setting cannot start spending.

results: The repository defines typecheck, lint, unit, browser and cross-browser test commands, plus scoped accessibility automation.
Deterministic features run without provider keys.
limits: It does not predict hiring outcomes or certify ATS compatibility.
Scores are heuristic. The repository marks production as not yet approved.
Live AI provider calls were not verified in the documented release.
next: Complete independent validation of the scoring before calling it production-ready.
